## Description
Briefly describe the change and what problem it solves.

## Type of Change
- [ ] Bug fix (non-breaking change fixing an issue)
- [ ] New feature (non-breaking change adding functionality)
- [ ] Breaking change (fix or feature causing existing functionality to break)
- [ ] Documentation update
- [ ] Refactoring / Test addition

## Checklist
- [ ] My code follows the code style of this project
- [ ] I have run `npm test` and all 33 tests pass
- [ ] I have verified TypeScript build (`npm run build`) succeeds with 0 errors
- [ ] I have checked that no `.env` or sensitive secrets are committed
